Critical invariants for contentful-core.php. Violations of these are high-severity findings.

1. NO SDK-SPECIFIC LOGIC. This library is shared between contentful.php (Delivery) and contentful-management.php (Management). Never add domain logic specific to either SDK. If you see CDA-only or CMA-only types, field names, or behaviors in src/, it is a bug.

2. BACKWARD COMPATIBILITY IS MANDATORY. Any change to a public class constructor, method signature, return type, or interface definition is a breaking change under Semver. The CI backwards-compatibility check (composer run test-for-bc-breaks) is authoritative. Do not merge BC breaks without a major version bump.

3. X-CONTENTFUL-USER-AGENT FORMAT IS A CONTRACT. The UserAgentGenerator produces a header that Contentful's API team uses for analytics and support triage. The format is: "app name/ver; integration name/ver; sdk name/ver; platform PHP/X.Y.Z; os <OS>;". Do not change this format without coordinating with the Contentful API team.

4. PSR INTERFACES AT CONSTRUCTOR BOUNDARIES. BaseClient accepts LoggerInterface (psr/log) and HttpClient (guzzle). The source never imports concrete logger classes. Monolog is a dev dependency for tests only.

5. EXCEPTION DISPATCH IS DATA-DRIVEN. Requester::createCustomException() maps API error sys.id values to exception class names dynamically. Do not add hard-coded error string literals or conditionals for specific error types outside this mechanism.

6. PHP 8.0 MINIMUM. Do not use syntax or functions unavailable in PHP 8.0 (e.g., fibers, enums, DNF types from 8.1+) without updating the composer.json constraint and bumping the major version.

7. DROPPING A PHP VERSION IS A BREAKING CHANGE. If composer.json narrows the php constraint (e.g., from ^8.0 to ^8.1), a major version bump is required.

8. DEVCONTAINER IS THE ONLY SUPPORTED DEV ENVIRONMENT. All tooling (composer, phpstan, php-cs-fixer) runs inside the devcontainer. Do not add instructions for host-side tool installation to CONTRIBUTING.md.
